purpose: Compare collection-first worker packing with one frozen alternative on exactly the same jobs,workers and budgets. Separate physically scheduled visits,bin-level mandatory collection completion,and the necessary twelve-bin delivery gate. No optimization,observed staffing or political-authority claim.
parents: All eight original network_duty_visits_20261112 b3_p0 plans and the four threshold-checked raw/corrected600/300farmhour,open120k-load food plans. Original network_visit_calendar_20261112 collection-first schedules are the immutable reference. Preserve every earlier result,map,packet and default. No spare-provider extension or target-grid winner selection.
fixed_resources: Same integer floor(supported staff),50 duty hours per worker/bin,calendar horizon7*365/12 hours,and mandatory divisible services A/B shared equally at calendar start. Same origin_trips,owners,directed collection costs7*(out+in)+0.25 and original point-visit providers/crew1or4/per-worker durations. No new people,food,roads,boats,workers,tasks or reassignment. Full-month availability and divisible services remain supplied assumptions.
alternative_order: After home services,merge collection and planned visit jobs and sort by decreasing PER-WORKER duration. At equal duration,collection precedes visits;collection ties use origin index then trip serial,visit ties use actor then target. For a collector job choose earliest-calendar-available worker whose remaining duty cap and month end fit,index tie. For a visit choose earliest available supported crew among workers whose duty cap and month end fit,index tie;start at maximum crew availability and finish simultaneously. Debit work per member;idle consumes calendar only. Jobs are whole and nonpreemptive. Failed jobs are recorded;continue shorter jobs. Grouping identical origin jobs is only a memory/runtime optimization and must preserve serial order.
mandatory_gate: In the mixed order,visits may be physically scheduled before a later collection job fails. Retain their actual intervals and duty hours. A physically scheduled visit is bin-qualified only when ALL original collection jobs and home services at that provider/bin are scheduled. Never silently discard already scheduled visit work when collection fails. Partition planned visits into bin-qualified,scheduled with mandatory-work gaps,and not scheduled. These are constructive packing outcomes,not proof of impossibility.
annual_gate: For BOTH original collection-first and mixed-duration-first policies,derive per-provider completion of all twelve mandatory collection/service bins,requiring the original active supported provider. Report original planned visits,physical/bin-qualified visits,and bin-qualified visits at providers passing this twelve-bin gate,plus all actors and bins. This is a necessary delivery-scheduling gate under the unchanged monthly food model,not daily provisioning,within-bin grain timing,empirical roles or complete annual food validation. Unaffiliated/mobile/missing inventories remain unscored.
cases_and_outputs: Eight scenarios times two fixed policies=16 comparison rows,all retained. Store eight mixed-policy monthly schedule sets,worker/task intervals,collection omissions,physical/bin-qualified visit masks,all per-provider duty/calendar ledgers,and both policies' annual gates. Original baseline arrays and files stay byte exact. Report gains AND losses in collection jobs,bin-qualified visits and twelve-bin-gated visits;no best-policy selection or map/default adoption.
controls_and_review: Manufactured collection-first fragmentation recovery,mandatory-collection tradeoff despite scheduled visits,equal-duration collection priority,distinct synchronized crews,idle-vs-duty accounting,zero workers/services/empty jobs,strict caps,deterministic ties,overflow and nonmutation before production outputs. Independent scalar mixed-order reproduction plus every worker interval/no-overlap/calendar/duty check,original trip identities/counts/costs and visit/provider identities,all request partitions,monthly channel ceilings,and BOTH annual-gate derivations. Exact current source/reviewer hashes,unchanged old maps/schedules and byte-exact fresh results/packets. Do not import the new allocator in the reviewer.
publication_and_continue: Publish all16 comparison rows,collection tradeoff/visit and annual-gate figures,methods/results/review/replay/plan downloads and a recorded calendar illustration in the normal research atlas. Post every new figure;browser/mobile/Windows and prior-map preservation checks. Review the ENTIRE release1-4/S1-S5 programme,commit/push then CONTINUE work. Dated size/occupation/provider functions,prospective transfer,complete diets/household/draftwork,daily provisioning and mobile/nonstate/unaffiliated resource integration remain open.
